about.title: Reputation isn't improvised — it's cultivated.
about.intro: MediaCraft Mozambique is a leading Mozambican company in strategic communication, reputation management and themed corporate events. With a global vision and local roots, we help brands, institutions, individuals and organizations navigate complex challenges, drive growth and strengthen strategic connections.
about.quote: Communicating means building bridges, inspiring people and transforming realities.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: We support brands, institutions and organizations in building effective communication strategies, authentic narratives and innovative solutions that drive their positioning and growth. Through strategic consulting, reputation management and transformative experiences, we strengthen identities, expand influence and promote sustainable development, generating economic, social and cultural value.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To be an undisputed reference in strategic communication, impactful content and memorable events in Mozambique and across Africa — creating powerful narratives, strengthening reputations and driving strategic connections that generate lasting value.

history.title: From two voices to a national narrative.
paragraphs: It all began with two women, Linda from Niassa and Vanessa from Zambézia, united by a shared passion: communication. Coming from different backgrounds, they followed different paths, facing the challenges and demands of the corporate world and shaping themselves through experience that only practice allows — until the day they understood that their country's story needed to be told by voices that belonged to it.

That realisation led them to leave the security of traditional jobs behind to build something bigger than themselves. That is how Criattus Mozambique was born, and later, driven by the same values and an even broader vision of the transformative power of communication, they brought MediaCraft Mozambique to life.

But they did not just found companies. They built bridges between past and future, between tradition and innovation, between who we are and who we can become. They saw communication as an act of identity and resistance, and reputation-building as a way of giving back to society — with values, purpose and legacy.

In a landscape where, for so long, narratives were imported and disconnected from local reality, Linda and Vanessa chose to put down roots. They brought an unshakeable commitment to diversity to the centre of Mozambican communication, creating spaces where different voices, ideas and perspectives meet and grow stronger — inspiring creativity, innovation and real impact.

At MediaCraft Mozambique, communication goes beyond service: it is a mission. It is a way of honouring stories, amplifying voices that deserve to be heard, turning dialogue into movements and events into meaningful milestones. Because communicating is not just informing — it is building memory, affirming identity and opening paths to a future where the African narrative, told by those who live it, occupies the place it has always belonged.

Linda and Vanessa took the first step. Today, MediaCraft Mozambique continues to amplify that voice through strategic communication, public relations, reputation management, branding, corporate event curation and creative content production — turning ideas into authentic narratives that connect brands, companies and institutions with their audiences. We build strategies that consolidate presence, stories that inspire and experiences that leave a mark.

linda-fernando.role: Co-Founder & Director — Operations and Business Development
linda-fernando.bio:
Linda Fernando is a communication and business development professional and executive producer, with experience working alongside governments, companies and institutions across Africa.

Her work spans strategic communication, institutional relations, business development and high-level dialogue platforms, with a particular focus on positioning organisations and initiatives, developing partnerships and bringing decision-makers together around business, investment and public-interest agendas.

Her background in entrepreneurship, media, communication, production and tourism allows her to combine business vision, contextual awareness, relationship-building and execution to identify opportunities, structure proposals, develop partnerships and turn ideas into concrete projects.

She was recognised among the MIPAD Global Top 100 Most Influential People of African Descent — Travel & Tourism Edition, Class of 2026, and is an alumna of the Academy for International Business Officials (AIBO) and the African Women Entrepreneurship Cooperative (AWEC).

vanessa-cadir.bio:
Vanessa Cadir is a communication, marketing and corporate events executive, with experience in communication strategy, client management, events, strategic partnerships and organisational development.

Her work centres on communication, client strategy, partnership development and event management, ensuring the structuring and delivery of projects that require coordination between clients, partners, teams and different stakeholders.

With experience across communication, marketing, entrepreneurship, business development and events, Vanessa combines commercial vision, relationship management and organisational and delivery skills in leading mandates, developing partnerships and coordinating projects.
